events.verdict: Sabonis (SAC) applies his forearm to Powell's (LAC) upper body and immediately removes his forearm as Powell passes the ball.
DeRozan (SAC) legally contests Jones Jr.'s (LAC) jump shot, making "high-five" contact after the ball is released.
Sabonis (SAC) firms up over his right foot in Leornard's (LAC) path and absorbs the contact to his upper body.
Jones Jr. (LAC) and Ellis (SAC) briefly engage and disengage during the pick.
Sabonis (SAC) brings his left hand forward and initiates contact with Harden's (LAC) arm that affects his follow-through.
Zubac (LAC) legally contests DeRozan's (SAC) jump shot attempt.
Harden (LAC) is bracing for the contact from Ellis (SAC) as they come together during the drive, and the contact as Harden releases away from Ellis is marginal.
LaVine (SAC) brings his left hand forward towards the ball, and marginal contact occurs with Powell's (LAC) arm as he passes the ball.
Sabonis (SAC) briefly grasps Zubac's (LAC) jersey as they pursue the rebound.
Murray (SAC) commits a take foul on Harden (LAC).
Harden (LAC) commits a take foul on LaVine (SAC).
Harden (LAC) inbounds the ball within five seconds.
Murray (SAC) cleanly deflects the ball away from Bogdanovic (LAC).
Zubac (LAC) establishes, and maintains, a vertical defensive position and absorbs the contact created by DeRozan (SAC) as DeRozan steps forward into him during his jump shot attempt.
